description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456 review F1): a caller's `javascript:` prop text substituted into a component body's `href="${v}"` — through a nested Outer → Inner — is refused; the value judged is the one that will be emitted.
rationale: §5.2 executable-sink rule: "The value judged is the value AS IT WILL BE EMITTED: in an expanded component instance, after the caller's prop text is substituted into the attribute, at every expansion depth". Before the fix this compiled to `setAttribute("href", `javascript:go('${…}')`)` at exit 0.
